gloss: fields, farmland (rice paddies and dry fields)

definitions.explanation: A collective term encompassing both rice paddies (田) and dry fields (畑). Refers to agricultural land in general.

examples.japanese: {田畑|たはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{耕|たがや}す→耕す：03934_tagayasu⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{田畑|たはた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The farmland suffered extensive damage from the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市化|としか}→都市化：05787_toshika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{田畑|たはた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: As urbanization progresses, traditional farmland is steadily decreasing.

notes:
WRITING:
A compound of ⟦{田|た}→田：03380_ta⟧ (rice paddy) + {畑|はた} (dry field/vegetable field). Together they mean "farmland" in the broadest sense, covering all types of cultivated land.

USAGE:
Often used in contexts about rural life, agriculture, or land use. Common in news about natural disasters affecting agricultural areas, urban development encroaching on farmland, and descriptions of countryside landscapes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {田畑|たはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{耕|たがや}す→耕す：03934_tagayasu⟧: to cultivate the fields
- {田畑|たはた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{荒|あ}らす→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧: to lay waste to farmland
- {田畑|たはた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: fields spread out
